name: Hamad Mohammed Bin Saedan Real Estate Company
summary: Hamad Mohammed Bin Saedan Real Estate Company is a prominent entity within the property sector, offering a full spectrum of integrated real estate projects and related services. Their extensive service array covers property development, asset management, real estate marketing and brokerage activities, alongside the management of real estate funds. Established in 1969, the firm operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
